summary: Preserved the six-track, 310-lesson and 2155-mission archive while adding runtime content contracts, bounded loading, real filtering, lazy full-note rendering and actionable errors.
Replaced unacknowledged localStorage autosaves with explicit IndexedDB workspace saves, transaction-scoped identity/revision checks, retained drafts, reviewed import and exact legacy preservation.
Added versioned CRUD practice projects with goals, evidence, status rules, search, pagination and deletion; corrected prerequisite checks, repeat XP, UTC recall scheduling and self-review labeling.
Added nine detailed junior-to-mid-level learning guides, reproducible tests and browser verification, pinned setup and curriculum candidate generation that preserves published content.

checks.environment: Windows; Node 22.16.0; React 19.2.8; TypeScript 5.9.3; Vite 7.3.6; Vitest 3.2.7; disposable Chromium 148
checks.command: npm test; npm run validate; npm run build; python verification/verify_browser.py; python verification/verify_authoring.py

limits: Local browser application with no server, account system, cloud synchronization, automatic grading or public deployment. Written evidence and self-review do not certify correctness.

Whole-workspace 8 MiB limit, 100 practice projects, 100000 characters per mission note and ten recovery snapshots. Replacements refuse full snapshot capacity; no automatic pruning, cross-tab merge or row-level persistence.

Legacy imports validate known identities, rewards, dates and histories; incompatible data requires manual review. The original localStorage text remains unchanged. Corrupt active aggregates are exported for review in a separate profile rather than automatically replaced.

Preserved curriculum commands and source paths refer to original course workspaces that are not all included here. Structural validation does not constitute a manual correctness audit of all 2155 reference answers.
Candidate authoring does not publish. A failed generation may leave an incomplete new candidate; packs, index and catalog require coordinated review and promotion.

One-browser verification does not establish full accessibility, all-browser behavior, guaranteed browser storage retention or arbitrary power-loss durability. Backend/authentication/booking tickets are future exercises.
